'''Poison sense''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It could be bestowed upon an individual after several [[Standard year/Legends|months]] of attunement to a [[Malachite crystal|malachite]] [[tasar crystal]]. [[Poison/Legends|Poison]] sense allowed the individual to sense contaminants in any substance, including those that were ingestible.<ref name="J15" />
